parsed.why: No state facility ban; gender-identity anti-discrimination and hate-crime law since 2019, panic defence abolished, 2026 court enforced the civil-rights act for a trans woman, X licences. Care/sports bans hit residents; high raw incident count lacks denominator. Above parent.

Independent July 2026 assessment places it in the low-risk tier; commission-enforced gender-identity protections, open marker rules, and a city sanctuary order expressly shielding travellers' care access. Weakness: no operative state hate-crime recourse. Highest of the five.

Top 'Do Not Travel' tier: birth-certificate bathroom law enforced with trooper ID checks, fines, binary-sex definition act barring marker changes, no GI anti-discrimination or hate-crime coverage, prison care denial. State-run universal exposure dominates; 7.6/100k killings near baseline.

Only law criminalising restroom use in private businesses, misdemeanour up to a year, effective July 2026, under challenge and not yet enforced; birth-certificate change barred. Harshest operative rule is universal-exposure state threat, slightly less entrenched than slot 3's enforced regime.

Worst-tier legal assessment; first state to repeal gender-identity anti-discrimination protection and bar local protections, leaving outed visitors no service remedy. Facility restriction reaches school grounds including visitors, but no general adult public-restroom ban documented.
